common_subset_policy: First ten index-sorted entries of packaged ci-v1-reasoning GPQA; frozen before inference; goal12 must reuse these IDs/content hashes to compare.
dataset_transport: Public Wanfq/gpqa mirror pinned to03ff68d77f7a4103ae2bf72fb099d358f6308b65; exact complete processed population matches packaged manifest. See subset-source/mirror.json. No prompt/scorer changes.
native_template_application: lm-eval emits structured messages using tokenizer_backend=None/tokenized_requests=False; vLLM applies native HF Jinja exactly once. Host validation passed; live verification required.
parser_source: vLLM0.30 parser/qwen3.py starts in REASONING state when thinking=True and switches at </think>; enable --reasoning-parser qwen3 to expose final content separately.
generation_cap_note: 16384 is proposed total-output cap for the timed client stage; run_config.json is authoritative. Official model guidance suggests reasoning up to262144 and final response131072, so smaller cap is a protocol limitation; all capped answers remain in denominator, with raw reasoning retained and absent final scored empty.
stops: No textual stop strings (until=[]), native EOS retained; removes upstream </s> textual stop while keeping tokenizer EOS behavior.
scoring: Upstream task v2.2 regex strict-match and multi_choice_regex flexible-extract, then upstream exact_match with ignore_case and ignore_punctuation. Only API final content scored; no correction of upstream scorer outputs.

reference.protocol_notes: Published exact-model GPQA Diamond score; local10/198 zero-shot lm-eval variant and output cap may differ. Published complete evaluation recipe not established from model card.
